caption: The drawing features a single, large, three-pronged metallic object centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background. The object has a brown, rusted, metallic appearance with each prong exhibiting a serrated or jagged edge. The central prong is the longest and straightest, while the two side prongs curve outward symmetrically. Below the prongs, there is a central oval-shaped opening which connects to a tapering shaft, ending in a conical handle that appears to be fitted onto a slightly lighter-colored, cylindrical base or grip. To the lower right of this main object, there is a small, finely drawn line illustration of a similar three-pronged object positioned vertically, but with no color or shading, resembling an outline or technical sketch. The background is otherwise unadorned and blank.
title: Sturgeon Spear
